people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Jacob’s sons came on the dead, and plundered the city, because they had defiled their sister.
translations.bsb: Jacob’s other sons came upon the slaughter and looted the city, because their sister had been defiled.
translations.kjv: The sons of Jacob came upon the slain, and spoiled the city, because they had defiled their sister.
